title: AI Study Assistant
summary: Teach a study helper with your own rules. It answers from keywords, with no secret keys in the browser.

steps.title: Add the header
steps.objective: Start the Study Assistant screen with a title bar.
steps.concept: A header sits at the top of a screen and tells people where they are.
steps.expected: A title bar appears at the top of the phone.

expect.label: A Header sits in the Header zone of Study Assistant
expect.fail: Drag the Header tool onto the glowing Header zone.

hints: Find the glowing Header tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Header zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Header, then tap the glowing Header zone.

steps.title: Name your screen
steps.objective: Give the screen a clear title.
steps.concept: The header will say “Study Assistant”. A clear title means nobody gets lost.

expect.label: The header says exactly: Study Assistant

hints: Click the header on the phone to select it.
Edit Text content in the Properties panel.
Type exactly: Study Assistant

steps.title: Add a safety note
steps.objective: Be honest about what the helper can do.
steps.concept: A study helper gives tips, not final answers. A short note tells people to ask a teacher for important things.
steps.expected: Your note appears under the header.

cmds: ADD TEXT "Study tips only. Ask a teacher for anything important."

expect.text: Study tips only. Ask a teacher for anything important.
expect.label: The message is exactly: Study tips only. Ask a teacher for anything important.

hints: ADD TEXT adds a line of text.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

target.text: Study tips only. Ask a teacher for anything important.

steps.title: Add the chat helper
steps.concept: The chat shows a conversation. When someone asks a question, the helper looks for keywords in rules. Your rules come first, then the built-in study tips.
steps.expected: A chat panel appears in the Body zone.

expect.label: A Chat helper sits in the Body zone of Study Assistant
expect.fail: Drag the Chat helper tool onto the glowing Body zone.

hints: Find the glowing Chat helper tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Body zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Chat helper, then tap the glowing Body zone.

steps.title: Teach your first rule
steps.objective: Give the helper a keyword and an answer.
steps.concept: ADD RULE needs a keyword (or several, separated by commas) and a reply. When a question contains the keyword, the helper sends the reply.

cmds: ADD RULE "homework" REPLY "Start with the hardest task while you are fresh."

expect.label: The helper has at least 1 rule

hints: ADD RULE "keyword" REPLY "answer".
Both parts go inside quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Teach two more rules
steps.concept: You can list several keywords in one rule, separated by commas, so different words can trigger the same reply.

cmds: ADD RULE "exam,test" REPLY "Revise a little every day instead of the night before."
ADD RULE "tired,sleep" REPLY "Good sleep helps memory. Aim for a regular bedtime."

expect.label: The helper has at least 3 rules

hints: Two ADD RULE lines, one per line.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Final style check: every colour, border, shadow and style
steps.objective: Give your screens the same colours, shapes and shadows as the model app.
steps.concept: Colours were chosen while you built each element. Now finish the whole look: every colour, background, border, corner, shadow and text style below must match the model app you tried at the start. Items you already set show a tick.
steps.expected: Your screens look exactly like the model app.
hints: Click the element on the phone first. The style box (Choose colours, borders and corners) opens by itself.
Follow the sub-steps one by one: each says which row to use and which option to click. The red dot shows where.
Text alignment and weight are in the Properties panel (right) under “Text and layout”.

target.text: Study tips only. Ask a teacher for anything important.

steps.title: Run and talk to your helper
steps.objective: Ask a question that matches a rule, then one it does not know.
steps.concept: The helper uses your rules first. If nothing matches it says it does not know, and shows you how to teach it.
steps.expected: The helper answers with your rule and then admits what it does not know.

expect.name: chatMatched
expect.label: The helper used a rule that YOU taught it
expect.fail: In the running app ask a question that contains one of your keywords.

expect.name: chatUnknown
expect.label: You asked something the helper does not know
expect.fail: Ask a question with none of your keywords, for example: What is the colour of the moon?

subs.t: Press Run Project in the top bar
Ask a question with one of your keywords (for example: homework)
Now ask something it does not know

hints: Press Run Project and watch the demo.
Type a question that contains one of your keywords and tap Send.
Then ask something unrelated and see how the helper responds.

objectives: Teach a study helper keywords and replies.
See how a rule-based helper decides what to answer.
Learn why a helper should say what it does not know.

mcqs.q: How does a rule-based helper decide what to say?
a: It looks for keywords from the question in its rules
mcqs.why: Each rule links keywords to a reply.

mcqs.q: What is a limit of a keyword helper?
a: It only knows what it has been taught
mcqs.why: Without a matching rule it cannot answer.

mcqs.q: Why add a safety note to a study helper?
a: To remind students to ask a teacher about important things
mcqs.why: Helpers can be wrong, so people need to check important answers.

mcqs.q: Why can one rule have several keywords?
a: More ways of asking will match the same reply
mcqs.why: Students phrase questions in different ways.

mcqs.q: What should the helper do when no rule matches?
a: Say it does not know yet
mcqs.why: An honest answer is better than a wrong one.

assistant.text: Study tips only. Ask a teacher for anything important.

rules.r: Start with the hardest task while you are fresh.
Revise a little every day instead of the night before.
Good sleep helps memory. Aim for a regular bedtime.
